notes.text: Scout (abstract-level only): F1 done before (MaxFusion, Cross-ControlNet); F2/F3 incremental (AtteConDA 2605.09425 closest threat); F4 PCGrad-style hint projection novel; T1 novel only as combination (modality dropout + fidelity knob + control-off distillation on few-step DiT).

data/depth/png/*.png are 16-bit; PIL convert('RGB') saturates to white so depth control was unconditioned. Use hint_fusion.method.load_control (near=bright, exterior set far, percentile stretch). Baseline depth path in run_experiment.py patched to use it.

Union-net hints are highly aligned (mean cos ~0.8); cos<0 only ~0.7% tokens, so conflict projection (F4) likely weak. Depth weight >0.3 over canny washes colours. canny_only fusion equals baseline bit-exactly. ~4.1-4.9 s/img, 26.9 GiB peak.

run_experiment.py 2-step warm-up leaves scheduler shift_terminal=2/3, so existing 8-step baseline/hint_fusion runs use a non-clean Turbo sigma schedule; init_sim overrides it with the clean schedule. Treat baseline rows as 'warm-up schedule'. Backlog B1.
